ip_vpn_scope_check.name: ip_vpn_scope_check
ip_vpn_scope_check.value: ("ip"."scope" = 'vpn' AND "ip"."vpn_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ip"."scope" <> 'vpn' AND "ip"."vpn_id" IS NULL)

ip_datacenter_free_pool_check.name: ip_datacenter_free_pool_check
ip_datacenter_free_pool_check.value: ("ip"."datacenter_id" IS NULL) OR ("ip"."server_id" IS NULL AND "ip"."vpn_id" IS NULL AND "ip"."network_id" IS NULL)

managed_status_check.name: managed_status_check
managed_status_check.value: status IS NULL OR status IN ('provisioning','applying','ready','stopped','failed')

network_single_scope_check.name: network_single_scope_check
network_single_scope_check.value:
(
        ("network"."kind" = 'datacenter' AND "network"."datacenter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "network"."server_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("network"."kind" = 'server' AND "network"."server_id" IS NOT NULL AND "network"."datacenter_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("network"."kind" = 'docker' AND "network"."datacenter_id" IS NULL AND "network"."server_id" IS NULL)
      )

uniq_storage_environment_compose_volume_.name: uniq_storage_environment_compose_volume_key
uniq_storage_environment_compose_volume_.where:
kind = 'docker_volume'
          AND environment_id IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(metadata->>'composeVolumeKey', '') <> ''

storage_exactly_one_parent_check.name: storage_exactly_one_parent_check
storage_exactly_one_parent_check.value:
((project_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (environment_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (service_id IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

variable_exactly_one_parent_check.name: variable_exactly_one_parent_check
variable_exactly_one_parent_check.value:
((organization_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (workspace_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (project_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (environment_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (service_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (hosting_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (server_id IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1
